replicated_originals.reference: klein Selle, Verschuere, Kindt, Meijer, & Ben-Shakhar (2016) Orienting versus inhibition in the Concealed Information Test: Different cognitive processes drive different physiological measures

A.reason: Riccelli et al. (2017) on surface-based morphometry and personality does not appear in the paper's text or reference list; the paper concerns the Concealed Information Test.

B.reason: The abstract states the study intends to 'provide a constructive replication of klein Selle et al. (2016)' using an autobiographical CIT, and it reproduces the response-fractionation pattern (SCR in both conditions; RLL/HR only under concealment).

notes: Constructive/conceptual replication: identity-related items replace the original's mock-crime items, and an item-salience manipulation is added as an extension.
